responseShape.description: Files in the folder (and its subfolders with --recursive); folders are not listed

files.description: Files, each with the fields below

mimeType.description: MIME type; Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides use application/vnd.google-apps.*

size.description: Size in bytes; absent for Google-native files

md5Checksum.description: MD5 of the content; absent for Google-native files

parents.description: Ids of the folders that contain the file

webViewLink.description: Link that opens the file in Drive

folderPath.description: Subfolder path below --folder-id, "/"-separated; "" for files directly in it
